name: SciCode
description: A scientist-curated benchmark for solving real scientific research coding problems across 16 scientific subdomains including physics, mathematics, chemistry, biology, and materials science. Contains 338 subproblems derived from 80 main research problems requiring domain expertise to even understand, let alone solve. The best model (o1-preview) solves only 7.7% in the most realistic evaluation setting.
evaluation_method: pass rate (code correctness verified by domain-specific test cases)
typical_sota_score: ~7.7% in the most realistic setting (o1-preview); ~20–30% with domain-specific background provided
reputation: Published at NeurIPS 2024; curated by active scientists in each domain; integrated into OpenCompass and inspect_ai evaluation frameworks; o1-preview solving only 7.7% demonstrates frontier models remain far from replacing research programmers
notes: NeurIPS 2024. Problems are curated by active researchers in each scientific subdomain, ensuring genuine research-level difficulty. Three evaluation modes: (1) with full scientific background, (2) with only problem description, (3) end-to-end (most realistic). Even with full background, all models score below 30%. 16 subdomains: condensed matter, quantum mechanics, astrophysics, biochemistry, genomics, materials science, etc. Integrated into OpenCompass and inspect_ai.
